'''Shon Kifar''' is a city in [[Seanchan]], located on the eastern shore.

It is the tenth largest city in the empire.{{ref|{{bwb}}}} Before journeying to the [[Westlands]] aboard the ''[[Victory of Kidron]]'', [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] purchases a ''[[damane]]'' she named Mylen on the docks of Shon Kifar. This ''damane'' is actually an [[Aes Sedai]] by the name of [[Sheraine Caminelle]].{{ref/book|9|14}}
